description: Where does this business operate? Returns its locations (sales-tax outlets, plus closed ones known from mixed-beverage receipts) with trade name, address, NAICS code, permit and first-sale dates, and whether each is current or ended. Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. Example: {"entity_id": "32057926266", "include_affiliates": true}.

entity_id.description: entity_id from resolve_business (11-digit Texas taxpayer number), or a 10-digit SOS file number.

include_affiliates.description: Also include affiliated entities (likely common control, confidence >= 0.5). Default false.

status.description: Only current or only ended locations. Default both.

name: get_locations
title: Locations of a Texas business
